title: One line of the tollman's held-back check runs (checks.jsonl)
description: Landings first on the runners (hal2 plan 0306; scripts/checks.py): `slot` is the field whose check it is, `id` names the deferral or dispatch the line is about.

id.description: `<slot>-<n>` (n: the time in seconds and three random digits): a deferral's, or ci-check's own dispatch's; on a cancelled line the dispatched entry's, on a superseded or failed line the deferral's.

pane.description: The session that dispatched the check (its pane or terminal host), told when it waits and when it runs.

argv.description: The whole dispatch command, `gh workflow run merge-to-main.yml ...`, sent again as it is.

cwd.description: The checkout the dispatch runs in.

run.description: The check run's id: on a dispatched line the run it made, on a cancelled line the run cancelled.

url.description: A dispatched line: the run's address.

again.description: A deferred line the duty wrote: the run it was cancelled from.

by.description: A dispatched line: `checks` (the duty) or `ci-check`; a superseded line: the id of the entry dispatched instead, or `stale` (older than checks.STALE).

attempt.description: A failed line: the count of the deferral's failed dispatches so far (given up at checks.TRIES).

why.description: A failed line: the dispatch's exit code and output tail.
